title: Claims Accounting Basis: The Amount Recorded Against a Refused Claim
content:
**Scope.** This basis works out the amount recorded against a claim refused on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, which is what the customer is left to pay for the loss once the work the coverage answers for anyway has been taken off.

**1. The claim and its work order.** The claim being answered is the one last entered against the plan, and the work order it was sent in on is the one carrying that claim's reference.

**2. The figure the refusal is recorded at.** The figure the refusal is recorded at is the amount the claim stands entered for on the coverage.

**3. The value the piece is taken at.** The value the piece is taken at is the value it was sold at.

**4. Routine work and goodwill already drawn.** The routine work and the goodwill already drawn are counted over the whole time the plan has been in force.

**5. Work the coverage would have answered for anyway.** Nothing is taken off the figure for work the coverage would have answered for without a claim.

**6. Goodwill.** Nothing is met as goodwill.

**7. How the two come off.** The work the coverage answers for anyway and the goodwill are both taken off the figure the refusal is recorded at, never off one another, and the goodwill share is worked out on that same figure.

**8. Rounding.** The amount recorded as refused is rounded to two decimal places once at the end, and is never below zero.

## How periods are measured

Whole months are counted to the handling date. The coverage year in progress runs from the anniversary of the day coverage began, and the months it has run so far are the whole months since coverage began beyond the coverage years already completed.

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

A claim stands entered against the coverage for 900.00 USD on a piece that was sold at 2200.00 USD. The figure the refusal is recorded at is 900.00 USD. Nothing comes off it for work the coverage would have answered for without a claim and nothing is met as goodwill, so the amount recorded as refused is 900.00 USD once the figure is rounded to two decimal places at the end.
